plugins.name: cache-status
plugins.description: Prompt-cache meter above the prompt, built on prompt-cache-control: read / wrote / new tokens per request, a live countdown, why the cache missed, and pop-ups before it lapses; plus what a re-ingest costs in your 5-hour window, what the cache saved today, Keep warm, Start fresh, and a /cache pane with a per-turn table and history
